create_ImageNetTrain_dataset: create an ImageNetTrain dataset instance with optional config and custom data root path
create_ImageNetValidation_dataset: create an ImageNetValidation dataset instance with optional config and custom data root path
create_ImageNetSR_dataset: create an ImageNetSR super-resolution dataset with configurable degradation function and downscale factor
create_ImageNetSRTrain_dataset: create an ImageNetSRTrain super-resolution dataset using a subset of ImageNet training images
create_ImageNetSRValidation_dataset: create an ImageNetSRValidation super-resolution dataset using a subset of ImageNet validation images
